description: Token-augmentation ablation: DistilGPT-2 (~82M params) trained with cross-entropy, three tokenization schemes for substitution/tactical-shift events.

metric_definitions.possession: "Ball Possession MAD%" from mad_summary.py: mean absolute difference between GT and GEN home-possession share (ball-touch event share), in percentage points. Directly analogous to paper's possession_mae_pp.
metric_definitions.shots: Average of the Home and Away 'shot' event-count MAD values reported under 'Home/Away Event MAD for Pass, Shot, Dribble' in mad_summary.txt.
metric_definitions.dribbles: Average of the Home and Away 'dribble' event-count MAD values, same source as shots.
metric_definitions.total_events: mad_summary.py's 'Total Event MAD' field. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: this is the mean of per-event-type MAD across all ~33 distinct StatsBomb event categories (home+away combined), NOT the MAD of the aggregate total-event-count per match. The per-match CSVs (events.csv) contain no literal 'total events' row, so this category-averaged MAD is the closest available proxy to the paper's total_events_mae and should not be treated as numerically equivalent to it.
metric_definitions.total_position_mad: mad_summary.py's 'Total Position MAD' - MAD averaged over player-position labels. Not one of the four requested metrics but included for completeness/cross-checking.
metric_definitions.total_zone_mad_8x12: mad_summary.py's 'Total Zone MAD' - mean absolute diff over the 8x12 pitch-zone event-count grid. Included for completeness; the primary spatial-grid ablation is E03.

no_aug.description: Substitution and tactical-shift events are dropped entirely from the training/eval token stream (event_to_str returns None and events are filtered out before tokenization).

untyped_aug.description: Substitution/tactical-shift tokens are present (e.g. 'sub - home', 'tactical shift - away') but carry no attack/neutral/defend label.

typed_aug.description: Substitution/tactical-shift tokens are labeled 'attacking'/'defending'/'neutral' based on incoming-vs-outgoing player role or formation shift (see token_for_substitution / token_for_tactical_shift in gpt_tagged.py).

verification.distinct_models: Confirmed genuinely separate trained checkpoints: model.safetensors MD5 differs across all three variants (see model_checkpoint_md5 fields), each 3.3GB. Training scripts (gpt_no_subs.py / gpt_untagged.py / gpt_tagged.py) differ in exactly the expected way: no_subs filters out substitution/tactical-shift events before tokenization; untagged emits generic f'sub - {team}' / f'tactical shift - {team}' tokens; tagged emits tokens computed via token_for_substitution/token_for_tactical_shift that compare incoming vs outgoing player role (defender=1/midfielder=2/attacker=3) or formation attack-defense balance and label the token 'attacking'/'defending'/'neutral' accordingly.
verification.eval_set_size: All three variants evaluated on the same n=600 matches (600 '*_results' directories under each variant's results/).

claim_check.paper_claim: Typed-Aug gives the best (lowest) MAD across all four metrics: possession, shots, dribbles, total_events.
claim_check.notes: typed_aug (Typed-Aug) is strictly the lowest-MAD variant on all four metrics, matching the paper's qualitative finding. The ordering between no_aug and untyped_aug is NOT monotonic across metrics (untyped_aug beats no_aug on possession/shots/dribbles but is worse than no_aug on total_events_mad and total_position_mad), so the paper's implicit 'more augmentation info = better' gradient only holds cleanly at the No-Aug -> Typed-Aug extremes, not necessarily through the Untyped-Aug midpoint on every metric.
